file_info.description: Common base positive prompt module for photorealistic cosplay generation

Crucial Constraints - Complete Photoreal: - The output must be an actual portrait photograph taken with a high-resolution camera such as a Sony A7R or Canon EOS R5.
- Maintain a hyper-realistic style where fine skin pores, peach fuzz, skin texture, and individual strands of hair are vividly palpable.
Crucial Constraints - Realistic Body Pro: - Absolute Standard: Apply anatomically correct adult female body proportions and completely ignore the unrealistic head-to-body ratio (anime proportions) present in the [REFERENCE_IMG].

- Head Size Reduction: Generate the subject's head size proportionally significantly smaller relative to her torso and shoulder width, conveying the 8-head or 7.5-head figure ratio of a real model. The head must sit naturally and small upon the shoulders; it must absolutely not appear oversized or like a 'bobblehead.'
- Appearance Criteria: A youthful, cute appearance with a short lower facial structure (baby face).
Crucial Constraints - Styling: - Thoroughly analyze and perfectly reproduce the costume design, hairstyle, pose, and camera angle from the [REFERENCE_IMG].
- The materials of the costume must convey the physical textures of actual real-world fabrics (cloth, silk, leather, metal ornaments, etc.).
Crucial Constraints - Background: - Analyze the background of the [REFERENCE_IMG] and generate the scene as if photographed in a real location possessing a similar atmosphere.
Crucial Constraints - Resolution & Aspec: - Maintain the horizontal/vertical pixel resolution and aspect ratio of the generated image exactly identical to the [REFERENCE_IMG]. Do not crop the image or arbitrarily alter the aspect ratio.

negative_prompts.Strictly Avoid: Oversized head, big head, bobblehead, chibi proportions, anime anatomy, unrealistic proportions, Anime style, 2D, illustration, sketch, painting, 3D render, plastic skin, doll-like face, unreal engine, CGI, distorted face, changed facial features
